constraints.constraint: The target is a television stand, rather than a setup with an attached showcase.
constraints.A_evidence: A TV sits above a low console/stand, with separate wall shelves and no attached glass showcase.
constraints.B_evidence: A TV sits on a freestanding low open-shelf television stand; no attached showcase is visible.
